_comment: NDB RWY 27 (KERBO) - data from a community-made approach plate by u/Griffin5000 (r/KerbalSpaceProgram, Feb 2025); our own rendering. Outbound 101 from KSC NDB to KERBO (D18.7), right teardrop turn, inbound final course 270, glidepath 3.06 deg, field elev 70 m, DA 170 m. Missed approach: climb straight ahead to D5.0 KSC (050), turn right direct NDB climbing to 1000 m. Altitudes MSL = 70 m + glidepath (DEST KSC 4.0k 213, 6.0k 320, 8.0k 427, 10.0k 533, 12.0k 640, 14.0k 747, 16.0k 854, 18.0k 960 m above the field).
